title: ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State
abstract: arXiv:2610.13778v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: State-space models (SSMs) maintain a fixed-size recurrent state, but reading and writing it at every decoding step can bottleneck hybrid models. This eager state management causes large state I/O with low arithmetic intensity, leaves speculative decoding no cheap rollback, and feeds state quantization error into subsequent recurrent updates. We introduce ReplaySSM, which unrolls the recurrence to represent the state as a checkpoint and a buffer of recent SSM inputs. This separates output computation from checkpoint updates. By updating the checkpoint periodically, ReplaySSM avoids state writes on most steps and roughly halves the dominant state memory traffic. Keeping recent inputs also makes speculative rollback a buffer-pointer operation and enables output-only verification without materializing intermediate states. translated_title: ReplaySSM：缓存 SSM 输入，而非状态
translated_abstract: 状态空间模型（SSM）维护一个固定大小的循环状态，但在每个解码步骤都对其进行读写可能成为混合模型的瓶颈。这种急切的状态管理会导致大量低算术强度的状态 I/O，使投机解码无法进行低成本的回滚，并将状态量化误差引入后续的循环更新中。我们提出了 ReplaySSM，它通过展开循环，将状态表示为一个检查点和一个近期 SSM 输入的缓冲区，从而将输出计算与检查点更新分离开来。通过周期性地更新检查点，ReplaySSM 在大多数步骤中避免了状态写入，并大约将主导性的状态内存流量减半。保留近期输入还使投机回滚成为缓冲区指针操作，并支持仅输出的验证，而无需具体化中间状态。同样的分离机制还允许低精度的检查点在大多数步骤中服务于输出计算，而更高精度的……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: ReplaySSM 通过将 SSM 状态表示为周期性更新的检查点加近期输入缓冲区，将状态内存流量约减半，使投机解码回滚变为简单的缓冲区指针操作，并支持以低精度检查点进行输出计算。
en_tdlr: ReplaySSM represents the SSM state as a periodically-updated checkpoint plus a buffer of recent inputs, roughly halving state memory traffic, turning speculative decoding rollback into a simple buffer-pointer operation, and enabling output computation with a low-precision checkpoint.
